title: feat: cross-link all modules and resources
description:
## Problem
Modules feel disconnected. Examples:
- Agent detail page doesn't link to its evaluations
- Evaluation detail doesn't link to the agent or runs
- Run detail doesn't link back to evaluation/agent
- Tenant detail doesn't show its workspaces/agents
- Workspace detail doesn't show its agents/providers

## Requirement
- Every resource detail page shows and links to its related resources
- Tenant → Workspaces → Agents → Evaluations → Runs hierarchy is navigable
- Click-through from any resource to its dependencies

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Agent detail shows evaluations list
- [ ] Evaluation detail links to agent and runs
- [ ] Run detail links to evaluation and agent
- [ ] Tenant detail shows workspaces
- [ ] Workspace detail shows agents, providers, etc.

title: feat: replace manual string inputs with dropdowns
description:
## Problem
Many form fields require users to type raw strings when they should be selects:
- Create Agent: workspace ID should be a dropdown
- Create Agent: runtime engine is a free-text field (should be: langchain, llama-index, etc.)
- Create Agent: pattern should be a dropdown (react, plan-and-execute, etc.)
- Create Evaluation: agent ID should be a dropdown
- Create Run: agent ID, evaluation ID should be dropdowns
- All forms: tenant/workspace context should auto-fill from URL

## Requirement
- All reference fields (workspace, agent, provider, etc.) use Select/dropdown
- All enum fields (pattern, runtimeEngine, status, etc.) use Select with predefined options
- Remove the need for users to type IDs manually

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No free-text ID fields in create forms
- [ ] All enum fields use Select components
- [ ] Dropdowns populated from API data
- [ ] URL context (tenantId) auto-fills where needed

title: fix: remove duplicate tenant selector from UI
description:
## Problem
Tenant selector appears in two places on the page, redundant and ugly.

## Requirement
- Single tenant/workspace selector in the sidebar or top nav
- Remove the duplicate selector
- Selected tenant context should be consistent across all pages

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only one tenant selector visible
- [ ] All pages respect the selected tenant
- [ ] Clean, non-redundant layout

title: feat: admin user system with first-run setup
description:
## Problem
No user concept. System only has tenants but no users/authentication.

## Requirement
- On first startup, generate a random admin password and print it to the console
- Add login page where admin enters this password
- First login = creates admin user (password hash stored)
- Subsequent logins require authentication
- Session/JWT based auth for all API endpoints

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Manager prints admin password on first start (only when no admin exists)
- [ ] Login page exists at /login
- [ ] All /api/v1/* endpoints require auth (except /api/v1/auth/*)
- [ ] First login creates admin user
- [ ] Password is hashed (bcrypt or argon2)

title: feat: production-quality UI layout and real data flow
description:
## Problem
- Entire UI feels like a demo/prototype
- Layout is rough and unpolished
- Data flow feels disconnected

## Requirement
- Professional dashboard layout with proper sidebar, breadcrumbs, spacing
- Real data relationships (not isolated CRUD)
- Loading states, empty states, error states all polished
- Responsive design
- Consistent design system (spacing, colors, typography)
- Real-time data updates where appropriate

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Layout doesn't look like a template demo
- [ ] Consistent spacing and typography
- [ ] Proper empty/loading/error states
- [ ] Responsive at common breakpoints
- [ ] Data flows feel natural and connected

title: feat: visual workflow editor with container-safe custom logic
description:
## Problem
1. Workflow editor has too many manual text inputs
2. Custom logic is implemented as Go packages - unusable in containers at runtime

## Requirement
- Replace Go package custom logic with a container-safe approach:
  - Option A: Python/JS snippets evaluated in sandbox
  - Option B: HTTP webhook calls to external services
  - Option C: WASM modules
  - Option D: YAML-defined step chains with built-in primitives
- Workflow editor should have visual node-based editing
- Drag-and-drop step configuration

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Custom logic does not require Go compilation at runtime
- [ ] Steps are configurable via UI without code
- [ ] Visual workflow representation exists
